role: adversarial verifier of s3_perkind (S3 family pooling with per-kind K)

checks.format: All 7 CSVs: 3289 rows, ids in template order, all non-answer columns identical to probe 5, finite and positive; only S3 rows differ (0 lab rows).
checks.rebuild: build_s3.py rebuilt into ext/s3kp/rebuild2 (8 s): all 7 CSVs byte-identical to the investigator's.
checks.legitimacy: The build reads test inputs (TS.pkl: test questions, priors, depth_info, cached Claude answers), eq3/transfers3 (built from test priors), the v3/probe-5 CSVs and the probe-5 merge decisions. The validation map (known_rows2) is imported but only called by the eval scripts. No rule keys on video ids or answer values: segment/base links, category, method, kind and eq groups only.
checks.hand_check: All 46 changed rows were checked against their pool members (ext/s3kp/S3_PK_DS_rows.csv, rebuild/dumprows.txt). Frames confirm the same boat, eagle, rock, streetlight, tile corridor, intersection (0074 = 0060/0067 scene: white van, taxi, purple sedan) and forklift/sports car. Units are m and m/s throughout. Speed members share the same time and identical timed depth entries (0299/0301/0310 forklift 16.7953->19.0980; 0300/0301/0311 car 17.8278->23.1989; 0039/0040 person and eagle).
checks.independence: Leave-one-fact-out re-run with the build's own pooled(): S3 sizes .800 -> .914 (7 rows, which are 4 independent facts once twins are merged: boat length +, eagle length +, yellow car length +, person height -). The held-out fact is excluded from every member's K by its line|value key, and there are no duplicate phrasings. The family proxies come from only 3 labelled clips; the mean delta is positive for each: 0034_seg +0.105/row (21 rows), 0060 +0.125/row (4 rows), 0300 +0.233/row (3 rows). Wherever constancy can be tested it holds: every transferred stated fact with a validation label on the receiving clip matches exactly (0060 white car 6.0 and yellow car 5.44; 0300 car height 1.15; 0098_seg boat length 10). 0034_seg's validation speeds also equal other clips' stated priors (boat 4, person 1.3, eagle 12). The choice of per-kind over raw S3 members was made on the same proxies (wingspan 1.591 vs 1.414, label 1.57), so the PK-over-P0 margin is somewhat optimistic; P0 alone still measures +2.6.

risks: Rock height (1671: 4.3 -> 7.8, 1691: 8.45 -> 7.8, 1697: 9.4 -> 7.8). One side view (0022_seg) against three oblique aerial views. This is the same view-dependence that the guard catches for rock width, but here it is not caught. No label exists. If the truth is about 4.4 the rows net -0.4 points; if about 7.8 they net +0.9.

Boat width: the pool (2.667) sits in the top-down cluster while the 0034_seg label is 3.27. This is a known -0.4 on 1141/1718, partly offset by +0.2 on the 0043 rows; it is already in the measured +3.4.
Bicycle wheel (0074): the D3 pool of 0.659 against the 0060 label of 0.56 gives -0.2; this is already in the measured number.

verdicts.S3_PK_DS: ACCEPT (recommended): 46 rows; measured +3.4 points on 28 proxy rows (+0.0059 S3); 18 rows have no proxy (-0.002..+0.004); expected S3 +0.006 (+0.004..+0.010), MRA about +0.0015
verdicts.S3_PKrepl115_DS: ACCEPT (conservative alternative): 27 rows, a subset of S3_PK_DS with identical values; measured +3.2 on 17 proxy rows; expected S3 +0.0055 (+0.004..+0.009)
verdicts.S3_DS: ACCEPT (minimal): 1 row, 1162 1.0 -> 1.3; same person motion as 0039 (identical depth entries); the series person speed is 1.3 (stated in 0025/0031; 0034_seg label 1.3); expected S3 +0.0005
verdicts.S3_PKrepl125_DS: REJECT (dominated): a subset of S3_PK_DS that still includes the risky rock-height rows 1671/1697 but drops most of the gain (+2.1)
verdicts.S3_P0_DS: REJECT (dominated): the same rule with raw S3 members, +2.6 vs +3.4 on the same rows
verdicts.S3_PKsize_DS: REJECT (dominated): drops the best-supported rows (0311 speeds: identical depth entries plus stated acceleration 5 m/s^2), +2.7
verdicts.S3_D3share: REJECT (dominated): +2.6 on the same proxies, and its LOFO is not usable because it copies D3 fact values

proposal_outside_scope.what: S3_PK_DS plus the T rule restored for 1115 and 1689 (0026 and 0026_seg person speed, 0.41/0.49 -> 1.3). The 0026 person depth entries are identical to 0025's, and 0025 states 'speed of the person = 1.3m/s'. Probe 5's S3 merge dropped this T on footage grounds, but that same footage method gives 0.33-0.57 in 0025, where the stated value is 1.3. The 0034_seg validation label for person speed is also 1.3 (measurement only). Expected +1.4 points if right (S3 +0.0024); the break-even probability is 0.58. Not adversarially verified by anyone else.
